digest.component_or_area: CodeQL security scanning & secret screen logging
propositions: Five CodeQL alerts for rule py/clear-text-logging-sensitive-data are false positives: the logged expressions contain either detector category names (constant strings from SECRET_PATTERNS) or stripped CLI arguments, not credential values.
Alerts 86/87 in _seam.py log families from secret_override, which are literal detector names assigned from override_record(), not the credential value being screened.
Alerts 83/84/85 in __init__.py flag the --allow-secret-pattern reason as tainted, but the reason is stripped from argv before the prints occur, so credential material cannot reach the output.

Regression tests pin the invariant that the CLI forced-write and usage-error paths never log credential values or override reasons, while still logging diagnostic category names and rejected arguments.
All five alerts must be dismissed via the code-scanning API with false-positive justification, and regression tests added to prevent future regressions.
